label: rateLimiter.consume.success
reason: Mongo-backed rate-limiter consume call is on the request path; its latency is likely the dominant cost of this middleware. Measuring until `next()` captures the overhead before handing off to downstream handlers and allows before/after comparison.

label: rateLimiter.error_handling.logging
reason: New `console.debug("rateLimiter.consume failed", e);` was added in a request middleware error path. If rate limits are hit frequently, added logging/exception serialization can impact throughput and tail latency; isolating this block quantifies the overhead.
